content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on Sales Invoice (list), a console error fires about 0.3 s after the screen loads, and the app then navigates back to Sales Invoice (new) about 2 s later with no user click in between, which suggests an automatic or error-driven return rather than a user choice.", "fix": "Fix: On the Sales Invoice (list) screen, check the load handler that runs right after the console error and remove or guard any programmatic navigation back to Sales Invoice (new), so the list stays on screen.", "cited_event_ids": ["app:1", "284", "app:2", "285", "287", "app:3"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The console error messages and their source are not in the events, so the link between the error and the return navigation is unverified.", "No user click or focus event appears between the list navigation and the return to the new form, so the trigger for the return is not visible.", "The element at roughly (125, 100) that the users clicked before reaching the list is not named in the events, so the entry point is unidentified.", "Whether the brief overlays on the list screen (about 17-25 ms) relate to the return is not established.", "Session-level counts and timings beyond the cited windows were not verified."]}
